executive_summary.headline: The builder signal is a control-plane layer around agents
executive_summary.body: This week’s projects add MCP gateways, privacy filters, verification browsers, durable queues, and research connectors. The differentiator is operational control, not a bigger prompt.

executive_summary.headline: Open-source agent infrastructure is becoming domain-specific
executive_summary.body: FreeCAD, legal research, Canvas LMS, and video MCP servers turn generic agents into constrained domain tools with inspectable interfaces.

top_picks.title: FrontisAI/OpenRSI
top_picks.author: community builder
top_picks.summary: OpenRSI ships an executable stack for measurable AI self-improvement, with a model, gym, RL, evolution tooling, and datasets.
key_takeaways: Small composable primitives are easier to govern than a monolithic agent platform.
Tool access must be explicit and auditable.
top_picks.results: Repository activity and release metadata verified on the linked project page.
top_picks.enterprise_adaptation: Implementation pattern: pilot the component behind a narrow internal API and a reviewed allowlist. Caveats: keep data residency, secrets management, model governance, and audit logging under enterprise control. 30-day experiment: run a non-production workflow on synthetic data, measure task success, tool calls, and operator overrides, then review the logs.
